Hi there. I can help. 

Look at the bottom numbers. 
We have a 3 and a 6. 
How do we get from 3 to 6? 
Do we times or divide? 
And what number do we use?

Not quite. Let us look again. 

To go from 3 to 6, we times by 2. 

Whatever you do to the bottom number, you must also do to the top number. 

The top number is 2. 

What is 2 times 2?
Is 4/6? Because bottom is times 2, so top is 2 times 2 is 4. next: 2/9 + 4/9?

Spot on! 4/6 is right. 

Now for the next one. 

We have 2/9 plus 4/9. 

Look at the bottom numbers. Are they the same?
I don't understand why. Why we keep bottom number same?

Think of a pizza. 

We cut it into 9 slices. 

The bottom number tells us the size of the slice. 

It is still a ninth slice. 

So the bottom stays 9. 

Now, add the top numbers. 

What is 2 plus 4?

Yes, that is wrong. 

Remember, the bottom number stays the same. 

It is still 9. 

So the bottom is 9. 

Now, what is 2 plus 4 for the top number?
Is 6/9 because 2 plus 4 is 6 and bottom is same. next: 1/4 + 1/8?

Yes, 6/9 is right! Well done. 

Now for 1/4 plus 1/8. 

Look at the bottom numbers. They are 4 and 8. 

Are they the same?
